description: Put a tracking item on one week. Adding one that is already there returns it unchanged.
name: add_sync_item
title: Add an item to a sync

description: Append a concrete behavior row (e.g. 'Date night every Saturday') to a value.
name: add_value_behavior
title: Add a behavior to a value

description: Soft-archive a person. They drop out of the active directory but their data stays intact. Prefer this over `delete_person`.
name: archive_person
title: Archive a person

description: Capture something the user wants to do. `personIds` links people to this item ('people I want to do this with').
name: create_bucket_list_item
title: Add a bucket-list item

description: Add a weighted edge from one goal to another. Both must be yours.
name: create_connection
title: Connect two goals

description: Create a new top-level or sub-goal. Pass parentId to nest under another goal. `position` is the {x,y} canvas placement — pick something around {x: 100, y: 100} if you don't have a preference. Add tasks separately with `create_task` after the goal exists.

description.description: One-paragraph description of the goal. Empty string is fine.

parentId.description: Goal id to nest under. Omit for a top-level goal.

position.description: Canvas position. Pick {x:100,y:100} if you don't have a preference.

title.description: Short goal title (the headline on the card).

valueIds.description: Existing value ids tagged on this goal.

name: create_goal
title: Create a goal

description: Add a new group. Color is any CSS hex like #f97316.
name: create_group
title: Create a group

description: Add a yearly-recurring date for a person. `year` is optional — used for 'turning N' math.
name: create_important_date
title: Record an important date

description: Record an actionable bid toward a person. `dueAt` is optional — bids without a deadline appear in the person's list but never on the upcoming feed.
name: create_next_bid
title: Capture a next bid

description: Add someone to the CRM. `category` is required: to_process (newly captured), exploring (decision pending), long_term (committed), or context_bound (situational ties like coworkers).

appreciation.description: Things you appreciate about this person.

myNeeds.description: Your unspoken needs in this relationship.

selfReflection.description: What this person teaches you about yourself.

name: create_person
title: Create a person

description: Add an entry to one of the Self list buckets. `patternCategory` is required ONLY when `kind = pattern` — server ignores it for other kinds.
name: create_self_item
title: Add an item to a Self bucket

description: Create an empty template; fill it with `set_sync_template_items`. `isDefault: true` makes it the one new weeks start from and clears the previous default.
name: create_sync_template
title: Create a sync template

description: Add a task to a goal. Difficulty is a vibes-based 1 (easy) to 3 (hard). `scheduledAt` is the optional deadline — omit for backlog. `referentIds` are people the user is relying on for this task; `groupIds` tag the task with cross-entity groups.

referentIds.description: People I'm relying on for this task.

scheduledAt.description: Deadline date or null/omit for backlog.

name: create_task
title: Create a task

description: Add an item to the library. It joins no sync on its own: use `add_sync_item` for this week, or `set_sync_template_items` to have future weeks start with it.

goalId.description: Goal this tracks. Omit or null for unscoped.

name: create_tracking_item
title: Create a tracking item

description: Create a new value tag. Color is any CSS-valid hex like #f97316.

color.description: CSS color, typically a hex like #f97316.

name: create_value
title: Create a value

description: Start the week containing `day`, with the items of `templateId` or of the default template, or empty when there is neither. A week has one sync: if it was already started, that sync comes back unchanged.

day.description: A day in the user's own time zone, YYYY-MM-DD. Usually today.

templateId.description: Template to start from. Omit for the default.

name: create_weekly_sync
title: Start a weekly sync

description: Hard-delete. Confirm with the user before calling.
name: delete_bucket_list_item
title: Delete a bucket-list item

description: Remove an edge between two goals. Both goals stay.
name: delete_connection
title: Delete a connection

description: Archive a goal and its associated connections + tracking items. Children of the goal become parent-less (not deleted). Confirm with the user before calling — this is destructive.
name: delete_goal
title: Delete a goal

description: Remove a group. Cascades to its memberships (people and tasks lose this tag).
name: delete_group
title: Delete a group

description: Remove the recurring date entry.
name: delete_important_date
title: Delete an important date

description: Hard-delete. Only use for entries that were captured incorrectly — prefer `set_next_bid_done`.
name: delete_next_bid
title: Delete a next bid

description: Hard-delete a person and what hangs off them: their bids, dates and links. Only for entries made by mistake. To stop tracking someone, use `archive_person`, which can be undone.
name: delete_person
title: Delete a person

description: Remove a Self item entirely.
name: delete_self_item
title: Delete a Self list item

description: Delete a file from a sync item, bytes included.
name: delete_sync_attachment
title: Delete a sync attachment

description: Delete a template. Its tracking items and every existing sync stay as they are.
name: delete_sync_template
title: Delete a sync template

description: Hard-delete a task. Confirm with the user before calling.

goalId.description: Parent goal id (used for ownership check).

name: delete_task
title: Delete a task

description: Remove an item from the library. If a sync used it the row and its notes stay in the database (`soft_delete`), otherwise it goes for good (`hard_delete`). Either way it stops showing on every sync, past weeks included. To drop it from one week only, use `remove_sync_item`; to keep the history, leave it alone and stop adding it.
name: delete_tracking_item
title: Delete a tracking item

description: Remove a value and untag every goal that used it. Confirm with the user.
name: delete_value
title: Delete a value

description: Remove a single behavior row from a value.
name: delete_value_behavior
title: Delete a value behavior

description: Full record for one person — reflection prompts, category, groups.
name: get_person
title: Get a person

description: The daily landing page in one call: this week's sync and how much of it is filled, the upcoming feed (important dates and next bids), open tasks on the month, quarter and year horizons, and the people who need attention. Start here for a daily check-in.

day.description: A day in the user's own time zone, YYYY-MM-DD. Usually today.

name: get_pulse
title: Get Pulse

description: Return the user's prose Self row (or null if not yet started).
name: get_self
title: Get the user's self portrait

description: The contents of a file on a sync item: an image as an image, a text file as text. The `url` on an attachment needs a browser session and cannot be fetched from here.
name: get_sync_attachment
title: Read a sync attachment

description: One week's retrospective: `weeklySync` (null when the week has not been started), its items grouped by goal with notes and attachments, `unscopedItems`, and `allTrackingItems`, the library to add from.

day.description: A day in the user's own time zone, YYYY-MM-DD. Usually today.

name: get_weekly_sync
title: Get a weekly sync

description: All bucket-list items oldest-first, with linked person ids hydrated.
name: list_bucket_list
title: List bucket-list items

description: Every weighted edge between active goals: `source` goal id, `target` goal id, `weight`.
name: list_connections
title: List goal connections

description: Return every active goal the user owns, with embedded tasks, value tags, parent-child links, and canvas position. The primary read tool for goals; call before mutating to learn the available ids.
name: list_goals
title: List goals

description: Every task tagged with the group, joined with the parent goal's context.
name: list_group_tasks
title: Tasks in a group

description: All groups the user has defined. Each group can tag people AND tasks.
name: list_groups
title: List groups

description: Yearly-recurring dates across people. Pass personId to filter to one person, omit for all dates sorted by month/day.
name: list_important_dates
title: List important dates

description: All open + completed bids for one person, ordered oldest-first.
name: list_next_bids
title: List next bids for a person

description: Directory of every person the user tracks, with their categories and group memberships.
name: list_people
title: List people

description: Read-only: bucket-list items where this person is one of the 'people I want to do this with'.
name: list_person_bucket_list
title: Bucket-list items linked to a person

description: Return every task where this person is listed as a referent, joined with the parent goal's context. Use to answer 'what am I depending on X for?'
name: list_person_tasks
title: Tasks I'm relying on this person for

description: Return every list-shaped Self item across all kinds (energizer, drainer, just_for_me, proud, pattern, trigger, release, year_ahead). Group client-side by `kind`.
name: list_self_items
title: List Self list items

description: Every template with its items in order. At most one has `isDefault: true`.
name: list_sync_templates
title: List sync templates

description: Every active item in the library, optionally for one goal. Items with `goalId: null` are unscoped. Call before adding items to a sync or a template, to learn the ids.
name: list_tracking_items
title: List tracking items

description: Open bids with a `dueAt` falling within the window, across every active person. Joined with person name + emoji. Default window 60 days.
name: list_upcoming_next_bids
title: Upcoming bids across all people

description: Return the ordered list of behavior rows attached to a value — concrete evidence the user uses to confirm they're living it.
name: list_value_behaviors
title: List behaviors for a value

description: All values defined by the user, with names and colors. Call before tagging goals so you have the right ids.
name: list_values
title: List values

description: Delete your avatar image.
name: remove_avatar
title: Remove your avatar

description: Take an item off one week, along with its notes and attachments. The tracking item stays in the library.
name: remove_sync_item
title: Remove an item from a sync

description: Set the order of the items in one `kind` of Self list.
name: reorder_self_items
title: Reorder a Self list

description: Set the order of items within one sync. Each `id` is a sync item id.
name: reorder_sync_items
title: Reorder a sync

name: set_avatar

description: Toggle completion. Done bids stay visible — the trail of fulfilled bids is intentional.

description: Lightweight alternative to `update_person` when you only need to change the category (and optionally the order within the column).
name: set_person_category

description: Use an image as this person's picture, in place of their emoji. `data` is base64 and must really be an image.
name: set_person_photo
title: Set a person's photo

description: Replace the notes on one item of a sync. It replaces rather than appends, so read the item first when adding to what is there. `weeklySyncItemId` is the item's `id` in `get_weekly_sync` or `get_pulse`, not its `trackingItemId`.
name: set_sync_item_text

name: set_sync_template_items

description: Update only a task's `scheduledAt` deadline. Pass null to move the task back to the backlog (unscheduled). Prefer this over `update_task` when scheduling is the only change.

scheduledAt.description: New deadline date, or null to unschedule.

name: set_task_scheduled

description: Set or clear the completion timestamp on a bucket-list item.
name: toggle_bucket_list_done
title: Mark a bucket-list item done (or undone)

description: Restore a previously archived person to the active directory.
name: unarchive_person
title: Unarchive a person

title: Update a bucket-list item

description: Set the weight of an edge. To change its ends, delete it and create another.
name: update_connection
title: Change a connection weight

parentId.description: New parent goal id (or omit to leave unchanged).

valueIds.description: Replace the goal's value tags with this set if passed.

name: update_goal
title: Update a goal

description: Rename, recolor, or reorder a group.
name: update_group
title: Update a group

description: Patch label/month/day/year. Pass `year: null` to clear the originating year.
name: update_important_date
title: Update an important date

description: Patch content or deadline. Pass `dueAt: null` to clear the deadline.
name: update_next_bid
title: Update a next bid

description: Patch a person's fields. `groupIds` REPLACES the group set if passed; omit to leave alone. Use null on `decideBy` to clear it.
name: update_person
title: Update a person

description: Change your display name or the language of the app. Your email and password are changed in the app itself.
name: update_profile
title: Update your profile

description: Partial upsert of prose Self fields. Only the fields you pass get written; omitted fields are untouched. Passing null clears a field.

descriptionYear.description: Calendar year this description was written for.

thisYearSelfDescription.description: Who I am this year — a paragraph.

title: Update self portrait

description: Edit content or pattern category of an existing Self item.

title: Update a Self list item

name: update_sync_template
title: Update a sync template

goalId.description: Parent goal id (used for ownership check).
